title: Split the work
description:
Write `long long parallelSum(const std::vector<int>& values, unsigned parts)`.

Cut the vector into `parts` roughly equal chunks, add each chunk up on its own thread, and return the grand total. `parts` is at least 1.

- Give each thread its own slot in a `std::vector<long long>` of partial sums, so no two threads write to the same place.
- The last chunk takes whatever is left over when the size does not divide evenly.
- `std::accumulate(first, last, 0LL)` adds up a range.
